independent_reconstruction.auditor: /root/erdos_327, independent of the GC.1 and MC.1 author
independent_reconstruction.protocol: Read only closure_contract.json and the then-current decisive_lemma.json before writing and hashing the blind reconstruction; author evidence and verifiers were opened only afterwards.
independent_reconstruction.blind_scope: The frozen SHA covers GC.1 and the then-current MC.1 only. CR.1 was added after the freeze and received an ordinary post-blind dependency/scope check, not a blind reconstruction.

statement_match_details.GC.1: For every sufficiently large K, a prime K<q<2K and an arithmetic PG(2,q) line cluster in H_(2^K) have exact normalized defect -1, strict band (N/32,N], pairwise singleton intersections, nu=1, and tau=q+1>K.
statement_match_details.MC.1: The multiplier completion has the exact sufficiently-large-t collision cutoff and forces natural deletion density at least 1/(2 max(X,Y)); the proof also extends harmlessly when exactly one finite seed is empty.
statement_match_details.CR.1: Conditionally on residual o(2^k) transversals with summable all-prefix Carleson recourse relative to a fixed density-beta baseline, the explicit entry/revision reserve is a full transversal of density beta. No such arithmetic recourse family is constructed.
statement_match_details.variant: All shores are disjoint Finsets of distinct positive integers; support minimality excludes every proper {-1,0,1} signed kernel, not only subrelations in the displayed orientation.
statement_match_details.randomized_scope: The tau lower bound applies to every realized owner set that actually covers all circuits; an uncovered or uncharged post-alteration interpretation is not claimed refuted.

dependency_check_details.prime_budget: O(q^2 log q)=O(K^2 log K) odd primes can be selected below K^6, while each point or private raw value uses primes from at most two O(log q)-sized blocks and therefore has o(K) bits.
dependency_check_details.padding: The exact imbalance is Delta_L=K-C_L+2m with -m<C_L<m+1 and m=q+1>K, hence 0<Delta_L<4(m+1); even decrement is at most four and the final band is strictly (N/32,N].
dependency_check_details.minimality: A private odd prime on each path edge forces alternating coefficients along the connected path; only zero and the full signed relation occur.
dependency_check_details.intersections: Distinct point-prime blocks, distinct unordered bipartitions at each incidence, and unique factorisation exclude every private/private and private/point collision across lines.
dependency_check_details.incidence: PG(2,q) gives pairwise line intersection one; mixed point/private hitting sets of size at most q cover fewer than q^2+q+1 circuits, while one projective line gives a q+1 cover.
dependency_check_details.CR.1: Every T_m lies in the entry-or-revision union; geometric convolution controls entry mass, the all-prefix recourse hypothesis gives an l1-tail bound for revisions, and a factor-two dyadic comparison yields full natural density. The periodic-baseline premise M786G-13 remains open.

novelty_check_details: No public search for an exact Erdos 786 solution or benchmark was performed under the open-math restriction. The theorem is independently proved, but no publication-priority claim is made.

machine_reproduced.scope: Finite guards corroborate incidence, exact tau/nu, multiplier products, owner identities, and graph-product constructions; universal GC.1 and MC.1 follow from the independently audited symbolic proofs, not finite extrapolation.

MC.1 is a supporting guard-only coherence obstruction and CR.1 is a post-blind conditional bridge; neither is part of the promotion basis.
